messages:
sam-sales: Hey folks — demo with Acme on staging just hit a bunch of 429s during a bulk embeddings + summarize step. Seen ~1.7k 429s over 10m. Anyone around? :sweat_smile:
anya-eng: On it. Can you paste a sample curl + request_id from one of the 429 responses?
sam-sales: Pasted from support: req_id=abc123-req, route=/v1/embeddings, status=429, body: {"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":0.5}
matt-sre: Looking at rate-limiter logs for tenant=acme-tenant — embedding calls consumed the tenant burst bucket. I see per_route_cap for /v1/embeddings set to 200r/min and a burst_window of 60s; concurrent chat requests then hit the shared penalty.
tasha-support: Customer was running a bulk import (100k texts) then doing interactive chat that triggers embeddings inline. Same API key for both flows.
anya-eng: That explains it — embeddings are token-heavy and the per-route cap + global token accounting caused exhaustion. Two immediate options: 1) temp bump per-route cap for embeddings for this tenant, or 2) carve a reservation for chat so it doesn't get starved.
sam-sales: Can we do a temp bump now? Demo in 45m.
matt-sre: I can apply a 2hr soft bump. Admin API we use internally:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/db/tenants/acme-tenant/quotas -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","rate":1000,"burst":5000,"expires_in":"2h"}'
```
anya-eng: Also recommend batching embeddings (batch_size=128) and enabling prefix/KV caching on massive imports to reduce token consumption.
tasha-support: Customer will want a simple explanation for security/compliance: is this a bug or expected behavior?
anya-eng: Not a bug — expected behavior given current quota config. The limiter enforces per-route and tenant budgets; a high-rate embedding workload consumed the shared budget and triggered 429s for other routes.
sam-sales: Please draft a 1-paragraph explanation I can send to their security lead.
anya-eng: Drafting now. matt — please apply the bump and paste confirmation/change id.
matt-sre: Done — change_id=chg_789. Applied per-route rate=1000r/min, burst=5000 tokens for /v1/embeddings on acme-tenant. Expires in 2h. Confirmed in control-plane logs.
deploy-bot: quota-service:deploy v2.4.1 — change chg_789 rolled out to us-west/us-east/eu.
tasha-support: Passing to customer. They also asked for a cost impact estimate for that 2-hour bump.
matt-sre: Quick back-of-envelope: if they saturate the bump for 2h at that rate, additional token usage ~150k tokens => estimated cost delta ~$18 for demo env.
sam-sales: Great, I'll relay that. Follow-up: schedule a short call with their infra team to recommend long-term fixes (separate API keys for batch jobs, reserved per-route quota, or Dedicated capacity).
anya-eng: I'll own the follow-up and send a short runbook with config snippets and a monitoring checklist.
sam-sales: Thanks all! :rocket:
